$comment: Curated OSV exceptions for scripts/osv-audit.mjs. Every entry names the advisory, why it is not reachable in this app, and an expiry date. Expired entries fail CI. Re-audit: 2026-10-12 (57 instances before remediation, 6 after).

ignores.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS via deeply nested patterns. braces runs only at build time (micromatch in the Tailwind/ESLint toolchain) on the project's own file globs; no user input reaches it, and no fixed release exists upstream yet.

Transitive only via @solana/web3.js inside @farcaster/miniapp-sdk, a code path the app never imports or executes (the SDK is used solely for ready/close/haptics). The only fixed line is stream-json 3.x, a breaking major for a dormant transitive dependency.
Same non-reachable @solana/web3.js transitive chain via @farcaster/miniapp-sdk; see GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x.
Same non-reachable @solana/web3.js transitive chain via @farcaster/miniapp-sdk; see GHSA-528h-pc64-c93x.
Build-time only (Tailwind/PostCSS processing of the project's own CSS). The fix exists solely in the 7.x major line; 6.1.3 already carries the same-line fixes available for this branch.

Concerns name-based uuid v3/v5/v6 generation with attacker-controlled namespaces. The only consumer is @solana/web3.js in the unused Farcaster SDK chain, and the app never calls name-based uuid generation. Fixed lines are uuid >= 11 (breaking major).
